title: Naturality of the coherently normalized integral Koszul braiding
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme $W$ on which $\ell$ is invertible in every residue field. Use the completed integral constructible category and its completed derived tensor $T^{\mathrm{int}}_{E,W}$ together with the coherently reduction-normalized integral Koszul braiding $\beta^{\mathrm{int}}_{M,N}:T^{\mathrm{int}}_{E,W}(M,N)\xrightarrow{\sim}T^{\mathrm{int}}_{E,W}(N,M)$ of [def-pod-integral-tensor-constraints]. For arbitrary integral arrows $a:M\to M'$ and $b:N\to N'$, the braiding is natural:
$$\beta^{\mathrm{int}}_{M',N'}\circ T^{\mathrm{int}}_{E,W}(a,b)=T^{\mathrm{int}}_{E,W}(b,a)\circ\beta^{\mathrm{int}}_{M,N}.$$
No finite-field, perfectness, boundedness beyond the constructible integral category, or torsion-freeness hypothesis is added.

proof.text: Define the completed braiding by composing the integral tensor model with the strict-system braiding and its swapped inverse model. The hom of this natural isomorphism satisfies naturality for arbitrary product arrows by `NatIso.naturality`.

proof.text: For each integral pair, package the completed-braiding component as an isomorphism in the constructible full subcategory. Unfolding the tensor model, reduction tensor comparison and swapped model cancels inverse/hom pairs; the adjunction counit naturality gives exactly the normalization equation defining `pullbackTensorIntegralBraiding_existsUnique`. Its uniqueness therefore identifies the chosen integral braiding component with the completed-braiding component.

Apply full-subcategory hom extensionality to the desired equality, rewrite both selected components using the normalization theorem, and finish with naturality of the completed braiding isomorphism. This proves the equality for arbitrary integral arrows, including identities, zero arrows, repeated objects, and the zero object.
